datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Honduras to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly near-term projection datasets for 2021, capturing spatial variation in food security status across administrative units.
